subject: Human Evolution
title: Seasonal Strategies
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Seasonal Strategies.

hook.text: In the wet season, fruit hangs everywhere. In the dry season, it vanishes. What do you eat then?

buildup.text: Seasonal food variation forced early hominins to plan, store knowledge, and switch tactics.

discovery.text: Mental maps of food sources—which tree fruits when, which riverbed has tubers—were survival tools.

twist.text: Baboons manage this. But hominins went further: they shared information about distant food sources.

climax.text: Seasonal planning likely drove memory, communication, and the social sharing of ecological knowledge.

punchline.text: Hungry seasons trained our planning brains.

quiz.question: How did seasonal food variation affect hominin cognition?
options: It drove development of planning and memory
